# vendor/ — third-party JavaScript, provenance

Downloaded 2026-10-08 with `npm pack` from the npm registry (approved by Miguel: "umap-js and tsne-js", 2026-10-08);
the tarballs' sha256 and the files copied unmodified. Since 2026-10-11 (publish review K5) the UMD SOURCES live in
`build/vendor_src/` — a build input that never ships — and only the ES-module shims the build generates from them
ship here, beside the two licence texts and this note:

| source (build input) | package | version | licence | source file in the tarball | tarball sha256 | ships as |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `build/vendor_src/umap-js.min.js` | umap-js (PAIR-code, Google) | 1.4.0 | Apache-2.0 per the shipped `LICENSE.umap-js` (the registry's metadata says MIT; the LICENSE text governs) | `package/lib/umap-js.min.js` | 74e57b60f307d198467fc7cf51c5116c0e2e4c94d7676be9ccec148cad073d2a | `vendor/umap-js.esm.js` (generated by `build/build_web.py`: a CommonJS prelude + the minified text unmodified + `export default module.exports`) |
| `build/vendor_src/tsne.min.js` | tsne-js (scienceai) | 1.0.3 | Apache-2.0 (`LICENSE.tsne-js`, and the registry agrees) | `package/build/tsne.min.js` | c678bf40e92e876e5d805b611bdd18ad11a138aa5408879cc477303cf535ec38 | `vendor/tsne.esm.js` (generated the same way) |

Both are UMD bundles (a global `UMAP` / `TSNE` when loaded as a classic script; usable in a classic Web Worker
through `importScripts`, or wrapped for an ES module — which is what the shims do for the module worker
`core/recompute_worker.js`). `d3.v7.min.js` (ISC) is copied by the build from iris's vendor folder and is not listed
here. Note: both packages ship the Apache License 2.0 text; umap-js's registry metadata says MIT, which does not match
its LICENSE file — the about page credits both as Apache-2.0. The sha16 of each source is recorded in
`build/build_info.json` (`sources["build/vendor_src/…"]`, `shims`).
